name: stack_not_in_classic_or_duel
description: classic (M1's game, untouched) and Undertow (the duel's shared clock needs a window between waves) never stack (contract-m8 §1 and §2): a Ready during a wave is refused WRONG_PHASE in both, as before M8, never NO_STACK; their rules hold one wave a road (stack_max absent in classic, 1 in Undertow, no stake), can_stack is false and stack_pay [0, 0]. Neither takes a level: asked for Hard, both play Normal's lives. contract_ids_keep_state_hashes holds the classic match to its recorded hashes besides.

steps.assert: not scene.preset('classic').has('stack_max') and not scene.preset('classic').has('stake_pm') and scene.client(1).stack_max == 1
steps.msg: classic holds one wave a road
classic asked for Hard plays Normal

steps.assert: scene.client(1).hollows[0].phase == 1 and scene.refusals(1) == ['WRONG_PHASE'] and not scene.client(1).can_stack(0) and scene.client(1).stack_pay(0) == [0, 0]
steps.msg: classic refuses a Ready in its wave WRONG_PHASE
and no wave was called behind it

steps.assert: scene.client(1).stack_max == 1 and scene.preset('undertow')['stack_max'] == 1 and not scene.preset('undertow').has('stake_pm') and scene.client(1).level == 0 and scene.client(1).teams[0].lives == 20 and scene.client(1).teams[1].lives == 20
steps.msg: the duel holds one wave a road and plays Normal

steps.assert: scene.refusals(1) == ['WRONG_PHASE'] and scene.refusals(2) == ['WRONG_PHASE'] and not scene.client(1).can_stack(0) and not scene.client(1).can_stack(1) and scene.client(1).stack_pay(1) == [0, 0]
steps.msg: the duel refuses a Ready in its wave WRONG_PHASE
